title: Design Director
description:
**Design Director** 




**Orangery® — Guildford, Surrey** 




**Full\-time · Hybrid · £62,000–£68,000** 




  





**\-\-\-\-** 




  





**We're a six\-person B\-Corp studio in Guildford looking for a Design Director. A senior, hands\-on creative who can take an idea, elevate it, and drive it through to work we're all proud to put our name on.** 




  





 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. The other half is varied: rebrands, strategic design projects and campaigns for clients across technology and B2B.
 



  





 You'll work closely with our Executive Creative Director, and you'll direct our freelance bench of 2D, 3D, animation, film and photography specialists, setting the standard and holding the line on quality. There's real scope to get out on shoots, directing photography and video. We're genuinely collaborative — ideas come from everywhere here, and the best one wins regardless of who had it. Leadership is earned, and it's there to take.
 



  





 Everyone here is senior enough to manage their own work and their own diary, and is trusted to get on with it. No unnecessary layers, no agency politics.
 



  





 We're also early in our AI journey, building it into how we brief, research and produce. If that interests you, it's a good moment to join.
 



  





**The role** 




  




* Leading creative direction across brand and campaign work
* Developing campaign ideas that work across multiple channels — social\-first content through to print and environmental
* Building and evolving brand identities, visual systems, guidelines and campaign toolkits for regional and global rollout
* Directing our freelance bench, including film, video and photography direction and editing
* Quality\-checking work to both creative and technical standards before it leaves the studio
* Presenting and defending work directly to clients
* Bringing creative thinking into pitches and new business alongside the ECD



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* Around 8\+ years in an agency or studio, with time at senior, lead or director level
* A portfolio strong on both concept and craft, showing brand and campaign work — and evidence of consistency across volume, not only one\-off showpieces
* Strong conceptual thinking: you generate original ideas rather than jumping straight to execution, and you can turn a complex brief into a clear creative narrative
* Brand strategy awareness — positioning, audiences, and connecting business objectives to creative solutions
* Fluency in social\-first, platform\-native campaign creative
* An exceptional eye for detail and strong typographic craft
* Confident with print artwork and production
* Experience briefing and directing freelancers — photographers, filmmakers, animators and other specialists
* Experience with high\-profile brands and/or complex campaign rollouts
* Figma as your day\-to\-day, alongside advanced Adobe CS. Motion skills an advantage



  





**A word on sport** 




  





 A meaningful part of this role is racket sports — tennis in particular. We're not just looking for a fan. We're looking for someone who can get properly under the skin of a subculture and make work that people inside it recognise as true. If that's tennis for you, brilliant. If you've done it with running, football, climbing, skate or music, we're just as interested.

**£62,000–£68,000 depending on experience, plus:** 




  




* Hybrid working — ideally 3 days a week in the Guildford studio, 2 remote

* Genuine autonomy — you manage your own diary
* Exposure to a major global sports brand, alongside work in technology and B2B

 to

title: Head of Brand Design and Creative
description:
**Our mission**
 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
   

  

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub\-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
   

  

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer\-to\-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
   

  

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
   

  

****How you'll help us achieve it****
 We’re looking for a Head of Brand Design and Creative who is strategic, thrives for creative excellence and is operationally effective to be responsible for defining Wave’s brand expression at scale. You will build up and lead a high\-performing creative team, establish strong creative processes, and ensure our brand supports Wave’s rapid growth across Africa.
   

  

**In This Role, You'll**
* Define and lead Wave’s brand design strategy, ensuring it supports business objectives across all markets
* Conceive and implement scalable brand systems, guidelines, approval processes and quality standards to ensure consistency and local adaptability
* Build, structure, and lead a global team of brand designers and creative leads
* Establish clear creative processes, intake systems, prioritisation frameworks, and review cadences to improve efficiency and quality
* Partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product and leadership to align creative output with strategic priorities
* Lead and facilitate high\-level creative direction sessions and provide clear, actionable feedback that elevates the team’s work
* Collaborate and optimize relationship with external agencies, production partners, and vendors
* Set performance standards, mentor team members, and build career development paths


****Key details****
* This is a remote position and can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC \-8 and \+4\) with reliable Internet access.
* Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula
* Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
* 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance
* Unlimited vacation with a 20\-day minimum requirement
* $10,000 annual charitable donation matching


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in brand design or creative leadership roles
* Experience leading and scaling creative teams in high\-growth environments
* Proven ability to design and implement scalable creative systems and governance frameworks
* Experience operating across multiple markets or regions
* Strong strategic thinking paired with high creative standards
* Experience managing agencies and external partners
* Fluent in English (French is a strong advantage)
* Hold a BSc/BA in advertising, fine art, design, or a relevant field
* You will be occasionally be required to travel to our operating markets


****You might be a good fit if you****
* Have successfully built and scaled creative or brand teams in high\-growth, multi\-market environments
* Demonstrate strong organisational leadership, with the ability to implement structured processes and operating models
* Have a proven track record of translating brand strategy into scalable systems and consistent execution
* Are experienced in cross\-functional leadership and influencing senior stakeholders
* Bring experience managing external agencies and complex production workflows
* Have strong business acumen and understand how brand contributes to growth, trust, and customer adoption
* Combine high creative standards with operational rigor and accountability


**Our team**
* We have a rapidly growing in\-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
* We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
* We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
* We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021\. Our world\-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
* We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue .


**How to apply**
 Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.
   

  

 We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.
   

  

 Wave is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:

With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. **Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog\-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.


**What happens next?**
 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
   

  

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Experience Design Director - EA Sports Network
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Experience Design Director \- EA SPORTS Network
   

  

***Note: This is a hybrid role (on\-site work required from Orlando, FL) \- Relocation assistance is***
***available for this role.***
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and
   

  

 fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that
   

  

 connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are
   

  

 invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top\-
   

  

 selling videogame franchises, award\-winning interactive technology, fan programs,
   

  

 and cross\-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences
   

  

 that ignite the emotion of sport through industry\-leading sports video games,
   

  

 including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
   

  

 EA SPORTS UFC .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 Experience Strategy:
   

  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long\-term, multi\-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network\-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user\-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.


**Experience Innovation \& Data Informed Design**
* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next\-generation interaction models, including AI\-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real\-time sports feed integrations.
* Data\-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.


**Your Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world\-class, large\-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Creative Director (Remote US)
description:
**About Legion**
 Let’s be real, AI isn’t magic; Legion was built to move beyond AI hype—delivering secure, reliable systems that work alongside the people tackling the world’s most critical challenges.
   

  

 Born from a Department of Defense partnership and trusted by leaders across government and enterprise, Legion embeds intelligence inside complex systems, unlocking data, accelerating human workflows, and strengthening mission\-critical systems. We don’t replace workflows—we optimize them, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reliability inside the platforms our partners already use.
   

  

 With world\-class collaborators like Palantir, Nvidia, HPE, and Oracle, we’re building intelligent infrastructure that enhances human capability and drives impact at the edge and across a range of enterprises.
   

  

 We’re looking for bold thinkers and doers to join us in shaping the future of AI that’s secure, grounded, and built to work.
   

  

**Creative Director (Remote US)**
* You will set the creative bar in, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high\-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets\*\*\*
* Required: A link to your online portfolio or a PDF upload of your work samples is required to be considered for this role. (see options below to provide link or upload\*\*\*


**The Role**
 Legion produces a steady and growing stream of creative across brand, demand, product, web, social, video, and events. We are bringing that creative capability in\-house and closer to the team, and rebuilding it as an AI\-native creative function, while keeping our agency partner for the largest and most specialized bets. As Creative Director, you are the hands\-on operating core of that function: the senior creative who sets the bar, ships the work, and builds the prompts, templates, and playbooks that let a lean team produce like a much larger one.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role to start, a player\-coach who makes the work. You will report to the SVP of Marketing and partner first across the marketing team, including Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, and PR. You will work closely with the Product team on product design direction and in\-product visuals, and with GTM and Sales on enablement and customer\-facing materials. You will build and manage a small flex bench of designers and specialists over time, with limited contractor support to start.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Legion’s work spans national security, defense, intelligence, the public sector, critical infrastructure, and the national research labs, work that often matters most where it cannot be discussed. The creative function you build is how that mission becomes legible to the people who need to understand it. You will be building the creative infrastructure that lets Legion tell a hard, important story at the speed the moment demands.
   

  

 Legion is a remote\-first company and an equal opportunity employer. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a culture built on ownership, discipline, and mission. To apply, submit your resume along with a portfolio or work samples.
   

  

**You will work at two levels at once**
* At the craft level, setting the creative bar and personally shipping the highest\-priority brand, campaign, product, and web work.
* At the systems level, building the machine\-readable brand, prompts, and AI\-native workflows that make on\-brand speed the default for the whole team.


 The way we build for customers is the way you will build here:
 **a human sets intent, AI does the heavy lifting, and a human approves what ships.** 
 This is a builder’s seat, not a brand\-police seat. If you want to define how a modern, AI\-native marketing team creates, ships, governs, and scales creative work, this is that role.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Creative Direction and Hands\-On Execution**
* Set the creative bar across brand, web, campaigns, events, social, video, and sales materials, and personally design and produce the highest\-priority work. This is a hands\-on role first, a player\-coach who still makes the work.
* Translate complex AI, agent orchestration, edge, and national security concepts into clear, credible visual systems.


**Campaign and Go\-to\-Market Creative**
* Partner with Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, and Product Marketing on demand generation, ABM, launches, education, and field events.
* Build modular campaign systems, landing pages, social assets, email graphics, sales collateral, and executive materials that scale across channels and audiences.


**AI\-Native Creative Systems**
* Use frontier models and AI creative tools daily to build repeatable workflows that compound over time, across video, campaign kits, landing pages, social, product visuals, and decks.
* Turn Legion’s brand into machine\-readable infrastructure: reusable prompts, templates, kits, and playbooks, with human review at the brief and the final gate, plus clear guardrails for AI tooling, IP, and brand safety.


**Creative Operations and the Flex Bench**
* Build and manage a flexible bench of freelance designers, motion and video specialists, and other contractors from the ground up, deploying them for surges and specialty work as demand grows.
* Own intake, prioritization, briefs, review rituals, and clear SLAs from brief to first concept to shipped asset.


**Product Design Support**
* Partner with the Product team to help set visual design direction that brings the product in line with the Legion brand, raising the baseline polish of apps, Spaces, and features so the product looks as credible as it is capable.
* Oversee and produce product and in\-product visual support: icons, diagrams, app imagery, feature visuals, and lightweight in\-product creative.


**Performance and Measurement**
* Run creative as a measurable loop, from brief to shipped asset to performance read to the next iteration, in close partnership with Demand Marketing and Marketing Operations.
* Use performance signals to sharpen concepts, formats, and priorities, without letting short\-term optimization erode brand quality.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 8\+ years in creative, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high\-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets, with real hands\-on production and not just oversight.
* A portfolio that shows range and craft across brand, campaign, web, social, video, and product or technical storytelling, with both concept and execution.
* Daily, advanced use of AI in the creative process: frontier models such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, and AI design, image, and video tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway, Google Veo, Sora, and ElevenLabs. You use AI to raise both speed and quality, and you turn what works into reusable systems others can run, from prompts and templates to kits and workflows.
* Creative coding and prototyping. You can turn a concept into a working prototype using design\-to\-code and AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Figma Make, v0 by Vercel.
* A track record of turning brand guidelines into systems that others can run: reusable prompts, templates, kits, or workflows.
* Experience building, hiring, and managing a freelance or contractor bench, not just briefing existing vendors. You have stood up and run flexible creative capacity and scaled it as demand moved.
* Hands\-on motion and video production. You can storyboard, edit, and ship demo clips, launch videos, social cuts, and event loops, with tools such as Premiere, After Effects, Descript, and AI\-assisted video.
* Product and in\-product visual support. You can produce icons, diagrams, app imagery, feature visuals, and lightweight in\-product creative, and partner closely with Product Design.
* Strong command of Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, with the range to pick the right tool for the job.
* Strong written and verbal communication and a high\-ownership, low\-ego, fast\-moving style. You build the best available draft and invite reaction rather than waiting for perfect information.


**Preferred**
* Experience in defense, national security, intelligence, national labs, critical infrastructure, public sector, or other regulated, high\-consequence industries.
* Experience with ABM, demand generation, product launches, or full\-funnel B2B campaigns.
* Experience with lightweight web tools such as Webflow or Framer.
* Experience building AI brand kits or machine\-readable brand guidance that other people adopted.


**Required:** 
**A link to your online portfolio or a PDF upload of your work samples is required to be considered for this role. (see options below to provide link or upload**
 Compensation Information
   

  

 $180,000 \- $210,000 USD
   

  

***Equal Opportunity Statement***
*Legion provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.
   

  

 We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.
   

  

****Learn more****
* Candidate Safety \& Interview Process Notice
* Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
* How We Use Candidate Data
* Equal Employment Opportunity
* Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

 We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease.  Forbes Advisor is hiring an
 ****AI Creative Lead****
 to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on\-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, and a hands\-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character\-locked stills through AI video, lip\-sync, and voiceover to editor\-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.
   

  

 The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re\-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI\-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real\-ad output from output that just reads as AI.
   

  

 We are a human\-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short\-term decision.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own generation end\-to\-end for paid social and native creative: character\-locked stills, AI video, lip\-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor\-ready footage.
* Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot.
* Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native\-audio vs. img\-to\-video) and keep a live view of a fast\-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time.
* Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available.
* Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto\-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass.
* Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan\-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one.
* Own the generative\-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor\-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards.
* Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes.
* Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on\-voice, on\-persona, and matched beat\-for\-beat to the script (AV sync).
* Bring a direct\-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good.
* Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better\-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline.
* Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales.
* Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self\-serve the routine work.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands\-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables.
* A real grounding in direct\-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI\-generated or AI\-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi\-subject\-consistency image models, AI video (native\-audio and img\-to\-video), lip\-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade\-offs, not just tool names.
* Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame.
* Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re\-rolling until something lands.
* Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue.
* A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft.
* Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high\-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated\-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails).
* Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start\-up style operating environment where the tools change under you.


****STRONG PLUSES****
* Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work.
* Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it.
* Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters.
* Video editing or motion/VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: prompt libraries, character\-reference systems, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, or agentic tooling that compounds team output.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project\-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in\-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of picking up brand\-new tools fast and forming a real point of view on them, because this stack turns over monthly.

This is a hybrid director/producer role: you set the visual and storytelling direction for each series, and you also run the vendor relationships, timelines, budgets, and delivery process that get it made. You are the single point of accountability between Zing's leadership and its external AI production partners — translating scripts into production\-ready creative direction, briefing and managing AI vendors, reviewing every stage of delivery for both creative quality and operational compliance, and making sure episodes ship on time, on budget, and on brand.

**Creative Direction**



* Lead AI\-powered vertical short drama projects from script breakdown through final delivery.
* Translate scripts into production\-ready visual plans: scene breakdowns, shot lists, character references, location references, style guides, and AI production requirements.
* Guide AI image and video generation; review style frames, character tests, motion tests, rough cuts, and final deliverables, and give clear, actionable notes on continuity, performance, composition, pacing, and tone.
* Strengthen episode\-level hooks, cliffhangers, reversals, and emotional escalation for 1–3 minute vertical episodes.
* Maintain visual, character, and story consistency across episodes and series.
* Supervise post\-production — editing, sound, music, subtitles, and final polish.



**Production \& Vendor Management**



* Serve as the primary point of contact between Zing and external AI production vendors and partners.
* Own project timelines, budgets, and resource/vendor allocation across multiple concurrent productions.
* Communicate creative briefs, visual references, production standards, delivery timelines, and revision notes to vendors, and hold them to Zing's technical specs (9:16 format, 1–3 min episodes) and quality benchmarks.
* Manage legal and logistical documentation, including contracts, deliverables, and release forms.
* Identify production risks, bottlenecks, and vendor concerns; propose mitigations and escalate to leadership as needed.
* Enforce SOP compliance across all productions and proactively build relationships with new top\-tier AI production vendors.



**Systems \& Continuous Improvement**



* Build repeatable AI production workflows: vendor briefing templates, character bibles, prompt guidelines, review checklists, and delivery specifications.
* Translate platform data, audience feedback, and ad performance learnings into creative and production improvements.
* Help define Zing's internal AI vertical drama production playbook and quality standards.
* Monitor emerging AI tools, trends, and vendor capabilities to keep Zing's workflows and partner network competitive.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in vertical/short\-form drama production — as a director, showrunner, creative producer, or producer — with real credits in the format (not adjacent film/TV only).
* Direct working experience using AI creative tools specifically for vertical drama production, e.g. Seedance, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Flux, ComfyUI, Pika, Luma, or similar, in an actual production pipeline (not just personal experimentation).
* Strong understanding of vertical drama structure and mechanics: hooks, reversals, cliffhangers, emotional escalation, fast\-payoff storytelling.



**Also Important** 



* Proven experience managing external vendors, production partners, or outsourced/remote production teams, ideally across several projects at once.
* Strong visual storytelling ability — framing, shot design, blocking, mood, performance direction, edit rhythm — paired with equally strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Comfortable owning budgets, timelines, contracts, and vendor accountability, not just creative notes.
* Strong taste in commercial, female\-driven vertical drama genres: romance, fantasy, revenge, billionaire, werewolf, mafia, forbidden love, melodrama, or similar high\-retention genres.
* Familiarity with production/workflow tools such as Airtable, Notion, or Frame.io.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable managing multiple stakeholders (leadership, vendors, AI artists) at once.
* Fluent English required; Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus for coordinating with overseas AI production partners.
* Must be based in or able to work from Los Angeles.
* A portfolio or work sample — director reels, vendor briefs, visual lookbooks, storyboards, or produced vertical series — is strongly preferred.

Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on\-brand, performance\-tested campaigns in minutes \- across every market, channel and language \- without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.
   

  

**Your mission**
 Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows \- connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems \- so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.
   

  

 You work day\-to\-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands\-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision \- you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.
   

  

 This track is for people who go deep on the systems side \- building, scaling, and governing the agents, workflows, and creative infrastructure that creative teams and clients rely on. Creative sensibility still matters (they need to understand what "good creative output" means to build for it), but the growth path is technical leadership and architecture, not creative direction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Requirements**
* Meet with clients, creative teams, and stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and operational requirements
* Facilitate workflow audits and capability assessments
* Identify where GenAI, agents, or automation can meaningfully improve quality, efficiency, or scale
* Translate operational challenges into technical implementation plans


**Agent, Workflow \& System Architecture**
* Design and build production\-grade prompts, workflows, agents, and creative systems
* Develop repeatable, scalable frameworks that support multiple brands, markets, and channels
* Own workflow governance, quality control, and reliability of deployed systems
* Establish technical standards and best practices for how agents and workflows are built and maintained


**Enablement \& Technical Adoption**
* Lead training, workshops, and office hours to help teams adopt new systems
* Own technical documentation, playbooks, and guides for internal and client use
* Support change management as new tools and workflows roll out
* Act as the technical authority on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and constraints


**Platform Evaluation \& Technical Innovation**
* Evaluate emerging AI models, platforms, and tooling for technical fit and scalability
* Stress\-test new capabilities and provide structured, technical feedback to Product and Engineering
* Identify architectural improvements to existing agents, workflows, and systems
* Represent the technical roadmap for creative technology internally


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2\-3 years’ experience in advertising creative development
* Experience with GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Gemini etc.
* Experience with GenAI techniques such as model selection \& prompting
* Any experience using GenAI to deliver real\-world advertising creative
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud
* Good personal communication and management skills
* Preference for candidates who have prior agency experience
* Strong written English skills, allowing you to communicate effectively with clients and team
* Access to a reliable computer with an internet connection exceeding 40 Mbps
* A collaborative and team\-oriented attitude with optimism about the role of GenAI in creativity


**What Growth Looks Like**
* Art Director: owns creative direction across projects, sets visual/conceptual standards, mentors on craft.
* Creative Director: sets creative vision across accounts or brands, owns creative quality at scale.
* Head of Creative: sets the creative bar and point of view for the organization.


**Your Benefits**
* 25 days PTO plus public holidays
* Remote\-first, flexibility to work anywhere from your home country.
* Health insurance / private medical cover
* Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development
* Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.

title: Ad Creative Strategist
description:
**Role Summary** 

 : Responsible for strategising, analysing, ideating and briefing performance led ad creatives to find new winning ads to scale paid social spend, while leading the in house production team to deliver consistently high quality creatives.
 




  





**Reports to** 

 : Chief Operating Officer (transitioning to our Senior Media Buyer as they grow into a Head of Paid Growth remit)
 




  






 This is an ongoing remote freelance contract, you must be within \+/\- 4 hours of UK time (GMT/BST). We offer competitive monthly compensation and the autonomy to develop and expand within the role.
 




  





**Who is TAILORED ATHLETE?** 





 Remember the feeling of a new pair of football boots? Your first tennis racket? Your favourite gym shorts? And how it made you feel like you were going to perform better than you ever have… That's the feeling we replicate in EVERY one of our products here at TAILORED ATHLETE. As a team and a company we are here to unlock the full potential of Athletes to become the best version of themselves.
 




  






 As our Ad Creative Strategist, you'll be responsible for driving the performance creative strategy behind our paid social growth \- turning insight, testing and strong creative thinking into new winning ads that can scale. This is an ongoing freelance role working exclusively with TAILORED ATHLETE, embedded within our in\-house Growth and Creative teams.
 




  






 You'll work closely with our Senior Media Buyer (moving toward a Head of Paid Growth role) to analyse what's working, spot patterns and brief fresh new creative angles that convert \- while leading our in\-house video editors and graphic designer to deliver a consistent flow of high quality ads.
 





 This role requires someone who can combine creativity with performance thinking \- someone who can stand behind their ideas, communicate clearly across teams and keep standards extremely high without slowing the team down.
 




  






 If you want to be part of something that will challenge you professionally and personally \- giving you the tools, support and creative freedom to do your best work \- this role is for you.
 




  






 The question left to answer is this \- are you ready to be part of creating \& launching the most exciting and impactful products ever experienced by the modern day athlete? If you hear yourself screaming a big YES, continue reading.
 




  





**What's in it for you** 





 We're your biggest fans in becoming the best version of yourself and we care about building an environment where you can do your best work, stay healthy and feel proud of what you're producing. As part of this ongoing freelance role, you can expect:
 




  




* Remote working with flexibility, aligned to UK timezone hours
* Competitive monthly freelance compensation
* A high ownership role within a fast growing premium menswear brand, at the heart of a newly evolving Paid Growth team
* Direct access to performance data and the freedom to test, learn and improve quickly
* The opportunity to lead and shape a high performing in\-house creative production team
* A fast moving, structured environment with clear priorities, high standards and minimal distractions
* Close collaboration with our Senior Media Buyer, Media Buying, Creative and Product teams to build and scale winning paid social creatives



  






 You'll collaborate with a fast growing, visionary and diverse team. Our core values are: honest and open, learning and growing, vision and 'we get things done'.
 




  





**A Note On Where This Role Sits Right Now** 




  






 We're in the middle of evolving our Paid Growth team: our current Media Buyer is stepping up into a Senior Media Buyer role, on a track toward Head of Paid Growth. You'll report into our COO in the first instance, moving to report into the Senior Media Buyer as he takes on full ownership of the paid and creative plan. Day\-to\-day, you'll work directly with him (and, once hired, a Junior Media Buyer) on Ads Manager review and performance. This is a genuine opportunity to help shape how that structure works as it beds in \- not a role joining a fixed, static hierarchy.
 




  





**What you will be doing** 






  




* Lead the performance creative strategy across Meta (and TikTok in future), building a consistent pipeline of new ads designed to find and scale winners \- within the category and seasonal priorities agreed with the Senior Media Buyer.
* Own our bi\-weekly ad creative meeting and end\-to\-end process, keeping standards high, momentum strong and KPIs moving in the right direction.
* Review ad creative performance daily inside Ads Manager, working closely with our Senior Media Buyer (and Junior Media Buyer once in post) to understand what's converting, why it's working and what we do next.
* Break down winning ads into repeatable components (hooks, angles, copy, structures, thumbnails) to extend creative longevity and create smarter iterations.
* Write clear, performance\-led ad creative briefs for our in\-house video editors, turning existing assets into new high\-converting variations.
* Brief content creators with strong direction to produce raw assets that are built for performance (not just 'nice content').
* Write shoot briefs that ensure every photoshoot produces content we can actually use in ads, with a clear focus on hooks, angles and conversion.
* Translate product direction and brand storytelling into consumer\-first messaging that performs \- turning product features into angles, hooks and proof that drive action.
* Attend and support key ad creative shoots alongside our Content Producer, ensuring content captured matches the brief and aligns with best practice for paid social.
* Collaborate closely with our Product team to align creative direction, product priorities and brand handwriting \- while ensuring ads still convert.
* Lead and manage our in\-house creative production team (Video Editor(s) \+ Graphic Designer), driving a consistent flow of fresh, high quality ad output \- including goal\-setting, 1:1s and performance development, not just day to day direction.
* Support the video editors day to day by removing blockers, giving strong feedback and making sure briefs are always clear and actionable.
* Constantly mine our customer profiles, reviews and audiences to generate new creative angles that speak to different motivations and buying behaviours.
* Stay on top of what's working in paid social creative, bringing fresh ideas, trends and tests to the table while keeping everything aligned to the Tailored Athlete brand.









**Who you are** 




  




* You're a performance\-led creative thinker who knows how to turn insights, trends and testing into ads that actually convert. You've spent the last few years working inside a DTC brand or creative agency environment and you're confident owning the creative strategy behind paid social growth.
* You've got strong experience analysing ad performance in Meta Ads Manager and you understand what the numbers are telling you \- hold rate, hook rate, outbound CTR and CPA aren't just metrics to you, they're signals that guide what to test, iterate and scale.
* You know how to break down winning ads into repeatable components (hooks, angles, headlines, pacing and structure) and turn that into clear, actionable briefs an editor can execute fast \- without sacrificing quality.
* You're organised, structured and methodical in how you work, and you naturally hold high standards. You don't let sloppy briefs, missed details or rushed output slip through.
* You're confident collaborating cross\-functionally, especially with Product and Media Buying, and you can communicate your creative decisions clearly \- including when you need to respectfully push back and justify direction using performance data and testing learnings.
* You're comfortable leading creatives day to day, inspiring strong output without micromanaging, while still keeping a close eye on quality, consistency and pace.
* You're comfortable operating inside a team structure that's actively evolving \- you communicate proactively rather than waiting for perfect clarity, and you see ambiguity as something to help shape rather than a reason to hold back.
* You stay curious, keep learning and genuinely enjoy testing new creative angles and formats \- always looking for the next winner and bringing fresh thinking to the table.



  






 This is an ongoing freelance role, working remotely but fully embedded within the TAILORED ATHLETE team. You may have worked with other brands before, but during your time with us, you'll be focused, performance\-led and committed to building a consistent pipeline of high quality paid social creative that helps scale the brand.
 




  






 We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to creating a safe, diverse, inclusive and empowering culture at TAILORED ATHLETE, free from discrimination. While this role does require strong prior experience in paid social creative strategy, we're ideally looking for someone who has worked in fashion/apparel (either in\-house or through agency clients), as understanding product, brand handwriting and customer psychology in this space is a real advantage. We care just as much about mindset, standards and how you work with others as we do about what's on paper.
 




  






 If you have any questions or would like a casual conversation about the role, please email careers@tailoredathlete.com.

 As the leader in business and industry dining, Eurest is the company to join if you want a rewarding career packed with limitless opportunities.
