* Understand the relationship between editing, visual storytelling, *hook* structure, attention retention, and ad performance


Workflow \& Collaboration* Receive and interpret creative briefs, asking relevant questions upfront when clarification is needed
* Work closely with Creative Strategists and other members of the creative team to ensure visuals align with the intended concept and marketing angle
* Submit first cuts and AI\-generated assets within agreed timelines
* Respond quickly and accurately to revision notes
* Keep project files, prompts, source materials, generated assets, and exports organized according to team SOPs
* Stay updated on emerging AI video tools, trends, and capabilities and share useful discoveries with the team
* Support high\-volume creative production across multiple brands and markets

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We're Looking For* Proven experience creating or editing **short\-form video ads** for paid social, *UGC*, DTC, direct\-response, or performance marketing
* Hands\-on experience with **AI video generation and creative tools**
* Strong portfolio showcasing video editing skills and AI\-generated or AI\-assisted work
* Proficiency in **Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar professional video editing tools**
* Strong understanding of ***hook*****s, pacing, attention retention, CTA placement, and Meta/TikTok video formats**
* Ability to turn creative briefs and scripts into engaging, high\-performing video ads
* Experience creating multiple creative variations efficiently for testing
* Ability to combine **AI\-generated assets with traditional editing** while maintaining high\-quality output
* Able to work independently, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and respond well to feedback


Strong Advantages* Experience creating **AI** ***UGC*****\-style content**
* Experience with AI video tools such as **Sora, Higgsfield, Arcads, InfiniteTalk**, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with AI creative tools such as **ElevenLabs, Leonardo.ai, Freepik, and ChatGPT**
* Experience editing **DTC, e\-commerce, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, or consumer product ads**
* Strong understanding of **direct\-response advertising and performance marketing**


Instant No's* No hands\-on experience creating practical AI\-assisted video content
* No portfolio demonstrating relevant short\-form, paid social, *UGC*, or performance\-focused work
* Relies entirely on AI tools without strong editing, pacing, and storytelling skills
* Unable to work independently or handle a high volume of creative output
* Unwilling to experiment with new tools or apply feedback and revisions

  

**Benefits**  

  

Compensation \& Benefits* Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience, AI tool proficiency, and portfolio quality
* Fully remote with a flexible setup
* Clear growth path within the Creative and AI production function
* Learning and development budget
* Access to winning ad references and performance\-focused creative feedback
* Opportunity to experiment with and work with emerging AI creative technologies
* Exposure to high\-volume, multi\-market DTC creative production across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines
* Weekly performance reviews and structured feedback with the Creative team

  

We produce a lot of content and we move fast. If you thrive in a structured creative environment where your work gets tested against real numbers and you want to get genuinely better at your craft this is a strong place to be.

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.  


Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.  


The Role  
Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Director of LIMS Strategy, QualityOne, to accelerate our growth across global accounts in the Food \& Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), and Chemical Ingredients industries.  


In this high\-impact role, you will architect and execute the commercial strategy for our LIMS product line within these target sectors. You will act as the ultimate bridge between sales, marketing, product, and services, unifying them into a cohesive market vision while developing and personally delivering key messaging, training sales teams, and establishing industry thought leadership.  


We are seeking a visionary leader with deep expertise in laboratory informatics, strong market intuition, and relevant experience in the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain who can seamlessly pivot from high\-level strategy to hands\-on, day\-to\-day execution.  
What You'll Do  


Market Expansion \& Growth  


Drive Market Entry: Own the growth and market penetration of Veeva LIMS for QualityOne across target FMCG and their supply chain sectors  
Act as a Commercial Leader: Operate in a high\-visibility, customer\-facing commercial capacity to drive positive outcomes for both customers and Veeva  
Champion Thought Leadership: Serve as an industry evangelist by presenting at major conferences, leading webinars, and authoring content for industry publications  


Customer Engagement \& Deal Strategy  


Discovery \& Workshops: Lead customer discovery sessions to uncover pain points, define desired benefits, and co\-create solutions powered by Veeva LIMS  
Deliver High\-Impact Presentations: Support sales in creating and delivering compelling presentations to prospects, active customers, and executive stakeholders  
Support Deals: Help prospective customers build their business cases to justify investments and accelerate the sales cycle. Support sales in deal strategy, pricing and proposals  
Analyze the Competition: Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and develop tactical strategies and materials to win against competitors  


Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Strategy  


Influence Product Roadmap: Provide vital business and technology guidance to the product team to shape new or enhanced features in laboratory informatics software  
Enable Field Teams: Provide strategic direction and messaging to field\-facing teams while building strong relationships with executive leadership  
Coordinate the Customer Lifecycle: Align and coordinate resources across the entire customer journey, from initial sales to final delivery and beyond  
Build Communities: Engage deeply with communities of practice and manage relationships with both internal and external stakeholders and partners  
Requirements  


Experience \& Technical Domain Knowledge  


Informatics Background: 8\+ years of experience growing and scaling a technology offering at a laboratory informatics software vendor and/or a laboratory informatics consulting firm  
Industry Alignment: Proven track record working with Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), supply chain companies, or closely related industries  
Executive Presence: Proven ability to hold meaningful, strategic conversations with Heads of Quality, QC, and IT leaders regarding software applications and modernization  
Innovation \& Problem Solving: Demonstrated success innovating across complex business processes and technical solutions using critical thinking  


Communication \& Influence  


Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills  
High\-Impact Presenter: Dynamic presentation skills with the ability to be clear, concise, convincing, confident, and credible to any audience  
Relationship Builder: Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for collaborating and working closely with people  


Drive \& Execution  


Self\-Starter Mentality: Driven and highly motivated leader who is comfortable taking initiative and working independently  
Execution Excellence: Detail\-oriented with a strong, self\-imposed standard of quality, diligence, and a hard\-working "want to win" attitude  
Travel Flexibility: Ability and willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and presentations  
Nice to Have  
Quality \& Manufacturing Domain Expertise: Industry experience spanning Quality Control (QC), GxP quality content, training management, quality systems processes, or manufacturing  
Commercial Leadership: Proven experience leading or guiding global sales teams to aggressively pursue and close complex enterprise opportunities  
Executive Relationship Management: Seasoned background in establishing, expanding, and maintaining trusted partnerships with C\-suite and executive\-level stakeholders  
Established Authority: Published thought leadership pieces, whitepapers, or articles within the laboratory informatics domain

description:
**About RemotePass**


RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 1000\+ companies across 150\+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere \- and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.


RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product \- rated 4\.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150\+ countries.


We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund,

**About the Role:**


We are a rapidly growing company that specializes in providing comprehensive global HR and payroll solutions for businesses. Partnerships are set to become one of our largest sources of new pipeline over the next three years, and we are building that function now.


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to build that channel for RemotePass, deciding which partner types are worth pursuing, recruiting and signing them, and making sure the pipeline they produce is measurable and converting.


This is a hands\-on role. You will build the target lists, run the outreach, take the meetings and negotiate the agreements yourself. You will work closely with our Head of Sales, our account executives and our go\-to\-market engineer, and you will have direct access to our leadership team including our CEO.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Recruit and sign new channel partners in the priority segments.
* Review our existing partner relationships and decide which to invest in, revive or close.
* Help design the commercial model: referral and reseller terms, fee levels, partner tiers, deal registration, and the rules of engagement with our direct sales team.
* Establish roadmap priorities and quarterly focuses for the channel, and report on them monthly with the same rigour as a sales forecast.
* Design and deliver onboarding and enablement for new partners, so they understand our proposition and can position us accurately.
* Nurture existing partner relationships so that RemotePass is the provider they think of first, and so referral volume grows over time.
* Work with our go\-to\-market engineer to make partner\-sourced pipeline properly traceable in our CRM, so channel contribution can be measured and defended.

description:

**Why This Role Is Crucial Now**


ElevateCX is shifting gear from strategy into action across EUCAN \& International. The programme's success now depends on **execution excellence**, with significant focus on activating local brand teams and evolving ways of working, alongside closer collaboration with global teams to provide stronger above\-market support to countries.


**This Is What You Will Do**


You will be the execution engine of ElevateCX at EUCAN \& Int, reporting to the Commercial Excellence Lead, EUCAN \& International. Your mandate has four pillars: **activate and continuously support local brand teams** to to create Cx journeys and engage customers differently; **support the shaping of ElevateCX strategy while strengthening above market alignment**; and **embed agentic AI** wherever it adds value — moving the region from AI\-assisted to AI\-orchestrated CX execution. You will design, deploy, and govern agentic AI solutions that automate and personalise customer engagement across owned channels, acting as the regional bridge between global AI capabilities and market\-level execution. You will operate as the connective tissue between global marketing, medical and IT, the ElevateCX programme, and local commercial and medical teams across EUCAN \& International — turning strategic intent into adopted, measurable, compliant customer experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.


**You Will Be Responsible For**


**1\. Activating and Continuously Supporting Local Brand Teams to Engage Differently**


Lead the change management that accelerates markets' adoption of ElevateCX and the delivery of differentiated customer experience with a data\-first mindset. This is about **embedding** new ways of working so local brand teams actually adopt them — not just recognise them.


* **Design and drive the market activation following ElevateCX Action Plan aligned** with the customer engagement strategy: structured change plans per market, champion networks, adoption milestones, and hands\-on support that takes brand teams and field force from awareness to sustained new ways of working.
* **Move markets from one\-size\-fits\-all campaigns to personalised CX journeys** built on C360 and segmentation — coaching local marketing and medical teams (in line with the ElevateCX competence framework) to translate disease strategic plans into tailored CX journeys, segment HCPs, fully leverage C360, CX Journey Production Hub, emerging agentic AI solutions and capture voice of customer.
* **Unlock capabilities and co\-own the training approach**: partner with Commercial Excellence Lead and Global Training Teams (commercial and medical) on the design and rollout of the regional training and capability\-building programme
* Establish and run **Cx Journey Production Hub** governance across multiple stakeholders involved
* Own the relationship **external vendors** behind the Cx journey platform (SFMC), and **work closely with the Business Systems Team and RDU IT** to define business requirements and use cases, prioritise the roadmap against ElevateCX and market needs
* **Establish and run best\-practice sharing routines across the region** (digital leads sessions, monthly Ops meetings, support EUCAN \& Int roadshows) and measure adoption with leading indicators, acting decisively on resistance and gaps.

**2\. Supporting CX Strategy \& Strengthening above market collaboration between EUCAN \& Int and global teams**


Support the Commercial Excellence Lead, EUCAN \& International with the continuous evolution of ElevateCX strategy, while driving stronger alignment with global teams.


* Contribute to the definition and evolution of CX and omnichannel strategy, engagement models, and strategic frameworks that are actionable at market level.
* Act as a fundamental part of shaping **global marketing, medical, and IT alignment** with ElevateCX strategy — representing regional and market realities in global forums and influencing global roadmaps and content plans.
* Create clear ways of working between global, regional, and local teams that maximise ElevateCX and above\-market support for global teams, reducing fragmentation and duplicated effort.
* Maintain and evolve the CX governance framework, decision criteria, and prioritisation mechanisms for CX and omnichannel initiatives.
* Stay current with industry trends, competitor CX maturity, and emerging technologies (AI\-driven personalisation, next\-best\-action, modular content) to inform strategy evolution, and contribute to CX success metrics at experience and journey level.

**3\. Embedding Agentic AI Across CX Execution**


Focus on incorporating agentic AI in customer experience — constantly scanning where AI agents add value, and turning that into working solutions.


* Design and deploy AI agents (**Microsoft Copilot Studio**) that automate campaign operations across SFMC, web, and social — e.g., content adaptation and localisation, campaign QA, consent verification, performance reporting — with human\-in\-the\-loop review at defined decision points.
* Support defining the **agentic operating model** for regional CX execution: which tasks agents own, where escalation to humans is required, and how outputs are validated before HCP\-facing use.
* Own **governance of agentic workflows** in line with compliance requirements (GDPR, HCP consent, promotional review), partnering with legal/compliance and IT.
* Build market capability: train local brand and medical teams to work with agent\-supported workflows, and act as adoption champion for AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Contribute regional use cases and learnings to the **AI 2030 roadmap**, prioritising by value, feasibility, and compliance risk, in partnership with RDU IT and global AI teams.

**You Will Need to Have**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in omnichannel marketing, digital engagement, customer experience, or commercial excellence within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Proven, hands\-on experience as a business owner or power user of marketing and digital engagement platforms — **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Adobe (Experience Cloud), Sitecore, and AWS\-based digital services** — plus social media channel management in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated **change management experience**: driving adoption of new ways of working across brand teams or markets, not only designing frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience **building and deploying AI agents** in Microsoft Copilot Studio or an equivalent platform (e.g., Agentforce) — you have built and shipped something agentic, not only used AI tools.
* Demonstrated use of generative AI in marketing operations, and a clear understanding of **human\-in\-the\-loop design** and why it matters in a regulated industry.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, HCP engagement strategies, consent management, and regulatory/privacy considerations (GDPR).
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment in matrixed, cross\-functional organisations spanning global, regional, and local levels.
* Experience working across multiple geographies and translating global strategies into local execution.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and storytelling skills; analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into decisions.
* Fluent in English.

**We Would Prefer for You to Have**


* Experience in rare disease or specialty care commercial models
* Experience with impactful training and capability\-building programmes for marketing/medical teams.
* Familiarity with the Veeva/ Salesforce ecosystem (CRM) and CDPs/C360\-type customer data platforms.
* Experience with agentic patterns such as multi\-agent workflows and RAG over approved content libraries.
* Experience defining AI governance or decision\-rights frameworks.
* Vendor and IT partnership management experience (business requirements, roadmaps, delivery oversight).
* Additional European languages.

**Why Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease**


At Alexion, work isn't ordinary. As leaders in rare disease, our closeness to patients brings us closer to our work and to each other. Joining Alexion means combining the agility and pioneering spirit of a focused rare disease business with the scale, investment, and career opportunities of AstraZeneca. description:
European Union
  
  

**Work type:**  

Office/Remote
  
  

**Technical Level:**  

Leader
  
  

**Job Category:**  

Software Development
  
  

**Project:**  

American multinational e\-commerce company
  
  

N\-iX is looking for Lead Java/Kotlin/AI Engineer to join the team
  
  

Our client, headquartered in California, is a global e\-commerce leader connecting millions of buyers and sellers in over 190 markets. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on shaping, building, and scaling advanced AI systems at one of the world’s most established and heavily trafficked ecommerce platforms.
  
  

You will be expected to provide strong technical leadership through architecture, design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, technical strategy, cross\-team influence, and hands\-on execution.
  
  

**About the Role:**  

As a Lead Engineer, you will work across the full AI lifecycle: early exploration, rapid prototyping, system design, model and agent integration, evaluation, experimentation, production deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
  
  

Your focus will include Generative AI systems, LLM\-powered applications, intelligent agents, conversational AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and multi\-agent architectures. You will help define the technical direction for key AI initiatives while directly working on sophisticated engineering work.
  
  

This role requires deep hands\-on engineering ability, strong architectural judgment, AI systems expertise, and the ability to lead through influence rather than formal authority. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic tradeoffs, influencing senior partners, and helping teams turn ambitious AI ideas into durable production systems.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Lead the architecture, design, development, and optimization of scalable AI systems using Generative AI, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, and agent\-based architectures.
  
Serve as the technical owner or technical lead for high\-impact AI initiatives that span multiple services, systems, teams, or product surfaces.
  
Design and build agent\-led user experiences and backend systems that leverage task decomposition, memory, tool use, dynamic planning, retrieval, workflow orchestration, and multi\-agent coordination.
  
Translate ambiguous business, research, and product opportunities into clear technical strategies, architecture proposals, implementation plans, milestones, risks, and tradeoffs.
  
Drive architectural decisions for AI\-powered products and platforms, ensuring systems are reliable, maintainable, scalable, cost\-effective, observable, and production\-ready.
  
Contribute directly to complex implementation work across backend services, AI orchestration layers, model integration systems, evaluation frameworks, APIs, data pipelines, and observability tooling.
  
Partner with Product, Research, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to align AI system design with user needs, business goals, platform capabilities, and operational constraints.
  
Establish and promote technical standards for AI system design, agent architecture, LLM integration, evaluation, experimentation, responsible AI, production monitoring, and operational excellence.
  
Lead design reviews, architecture reviews, code reviews, technical planning sessions, and production\-readiness reviews for complex AI systems.
  
Mentor and guide engineers through technical problem solving, design feedback, implementation support, code quality improvements, and knowledge sharing.
  
Help advance the internal GenAI platform by contributing reusable components, APIs, frameworks, reference architectures, evaluation patterns, engineering guidelines, and shared services.
  
Define and improve AI evaluation practices, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, regression testing, model behavior analysis, quality measurement, human feedback loops, and production feedback mechanisms.
  
Monitor and optimize AI systems in production for latency, quality, scalability, reliability, availability, cost efficiency, safety, and responsible AI use.
  
Identify technical risks early and drive practical mitigation plans across architecture, implementation, launch, and operations.
  
Influence technical strategy across teams by aligning engineering decisions with broader organizational goals, platform direction, and long\-term scalability.
  
Stay ahead of advances in AI, LLMs, machine learning engineering, AI agents, retrieval systems, model serving, evaluation tooling, and emerging developer frameworks, applying a pragmatic lens to production adoption.
  
Drive continuous improvement across design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and operational processes.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

10\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, distributed systems, or related technical roles.
  
3\+ years of experience leading complex technical initiatives, setting architecture, mentoring engineers, or providing technical direction across teams.
  
Deep hands\-on engineering skills, with the ability to personally design and implement complex production systems.
  
Strong programming skills in Java, Kotlin or similar JVM languages
  
Experience designing and operating production\-grade AI systems, distributed services, APIs, or platform components that serve high\-volume, real\-world user traffic.
  
Ability to lead technical discussions, evaluate tradeoffs, influence senior partners, and communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical collaborators.
  
**Hands\-on experience with:** Spring Framework, Reactive Programming, Docker and Kubernetes, Distributed systems and scalable backend services, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, or other service/API patterns, Production monitoring, observability, alerting, incident response, and performance optimization, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment practices, and operational support
  
Excellent English communication skills
  
  

**Nice to have:**  

Hands\-on experience building agent\-led systems, including LLM\-based agents, autonomous workflows, task\-planning systems, tool\-using agents, retrieval\-augmented agents, or multi\-agent orchestration.
  
Strong understanding of Generative AI system design, including prompt orchestration, model integration, retrieval, grounding, tool use, evaluation, guardrails, observability, and production monitoring.
  
Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, ranking, knowledge\-grounded AI, or information retrieval systems.
  
Knowledge of tool\-use frameworks, agent orchestration platforms, AI workflow automation, multi\-modal model integration, or multi\-agent system design.
  
Experience building internal AI platforms, developer tools, reusable AI services, model\-serving infrastructure, evaluation platforms, or shared ML infrastructure.
  
Experience operating AI systems in high\-traffic ecommerce, marketplace, search, personalization, recommendations, ads, trust, risk, payments, or customer\-service environments.
  
Experience defining responsible AI practices, model governance processes, safety evaluation, abuse\-prevention patterns, or production AI monitoring standards.
  
Experience with streaming data systems such as Kafka.
  
  

**We offer\*:**  

Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
  
A competitive salary and good compensation package
  
Personalized career growth
  
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  
Education reimbursement
  
Memorable anniversary presents
  
Corporate events and team buildings
  
Other location\-specific benefits

title: Senior Technical Product Manager – AI Transformation (Product & UX)
description:
N\-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next\-generation software products. Founded in 2002, we unite 2,400\+ tech\-savvy professionals across 40\+ countries, working on impactful projects for industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. Join N\-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.


**About the Role**



Our customer is a leading European online car marketplace, serving more than 30 million monthly users across 18 countries.



They are launching a company\-wide initiative to embed AI and agentic ways of working into Product and User Experience. We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Technical Product Manager to help define, pilot and scale an AI\-enabled product\-development methodology across approximately 100 Product and UX professionals in Europe and Canada.



This is an individual contributor role for someone with strong product judgement, practical AI adoption experience and enough technical fluency to turn AI capabilities into repeatable, valuable ways of working. The focus is not on introducing isolated tools or use cases, but on transforming how Product, UX and Engineering teams collaborate throughout the product\-development lifecycle.



This position is available on a part\-time basis with flexible working hours (20\+ hours per week)


**What You Will Do:**


* Define and champion a clear vision for an AI\-enabled Product and UX organization, translating it into a pragmatic, staged transformation plan.
* Design, test and roll out AI\-enabled and agentic workflows across the product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements definition to prototyping, experimentation and delivery.
* Establish practical workflows in which Product Managers use tools such as GitHub, Codex or comparable AI\-assisted tools to create and improve product requirements, while UX teams use these outputs to accelerate low\-fidelity prototypes.
* Partner with cross\-functional pilot teams to identify high\-value use cases, test and refine new ways of working, and validate their value through iterative delivery.
* Turn proven approaches into scalable playbooks, templates, governance and enablement materials that teams can adopt independently.
* Assess AI tools, workflows and adoption barriers pragmatically, with a focus on business value, quality, usability and responsible implementation.
* Align Product, UX, Engineering and senior leadership around priorities, decisions, progress, risks and next steps.
* Structure, coordinate and track multiple transformation workstreams; measure adoption and impact, using feedback and data to continuously improve the methodology.
* Provide strategic direction while remaining hands\-on in the day\-to\-day delivery of the transformation.


**Must Have:**


* Significant experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Lead, Product Operations leader or in a similar product\-facing transformation role.
* Strong product background and credibility with Product leadership; ability to connect customer and business value with technical possibilities and make sound prioritization decisions.
* Demonstrable experience driving AI adoption, change management, product operating\-model transformation or internal enablement across multiple teams.
* Hands\-on experience applying generative AI, LLM\-based tools, copilots or workflow automation in a product\-development setting.
* Practical familiarity with GitHub, Codex, GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted development and product tools, including the ability to identify and implement valuable use cases for Product and UX teams.
* Good understanding of agentic ways of working and how AI can reshape roles, workflows and the product\-development lifecycle.
* Experience designing, piloting and scaling processes, operating models or ways of working across Product, UX/Design and Engineering teams.
* Strong program execution skills: able to structure, coordinate, track and report progress across multiple workstreams while maintaining momentum.
* Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with Engineering and understand APIs, software\-delivery workflows, data and limitations of AI tools. Coding expertise is not required.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written and spoken English communication skills.
* Comfortable operating under ambiguity and influencing senior Product and Technology stakeholders.


**Nice to Have:**


* Experience in a marketplace, e\-commerce, classifieds, consumer\-facing or high\-growth environment.
* Experience scaling AI practices across distributed, multi\-country organizations.
* Experience helping Product and UX teams improve discovery, requirements definition, prototyping or experimentation.


**What Success Looks Like After Six Months:**


* Pilot teams are using AI meaningfully in Product and UX workflows.
* A practical AI\-enabled product\-development methodology is documented, tested and ready to scale.
* Product requirements and early UX prototypes are produced faster and with greater consistency.
* Teams have the playbooks, tools and confidence to adopt the approach independently.
* Leadership has clear visibility into adoption, impact, risks and next steps.

**We offer\*:**


* Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location\-specific benefits


* not applicable for freelancers

Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-258826 **Date posted** 08/26/2026
**About Evinova**


Evinova enables global life sciences to accelerate better health outcomes through innovative digital health solutions for clinical research.


**Role Overview**


Evinova is seeking an entrepreneurial, AI\-fluent Product Director to take ownership of a core product area, building it from the ground up with AI at its foundation. This is a founding product leadership role: you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI\-native product that fundamentally changes how clinical development and clinical operations teams work—designing for the end user first, enabling seamless, collaborative workflows, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so that the platform works as one.


As Product Director, you will operate with significant autonomy and act as the general manager for your product area at Evinova. This is an individual contributor role: you will not have direct reports, but you will lead and inspire a matrixed, cross\-functional team—engineering, design, data science, and commercial—through vision, influence, and clarity. You will identify whitespace, validate opportunities directly with end users and customers, ship V1 products, and iterate relentlessly—embedding AI and machine learning into every layer of the product build, maintenance, and experience, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so workflows flow seamlessly for clinical development and clinical operations teams. This role requires a builder who thrives in ambiguity and brings the conviction to create something new within a world\-class life sciences software organization.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


**Build an AI\-Native Product from Zero to One**


* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for an AI\-native product, from first principles through scale.
* Develop a deep, first\-hand understanding of our users, their problem spaces, and their day\-to\-day workflows—pinpointing where the product can deliver step\-function impact rather than incremental gains.
* Drive rapid hypothesis validation through prototyping and experimentation.
* Own the full product lifecycle end\-to\-end: from concept and design through development, launch, go\-to\-market, and post\-launch iteration informed by usage data and customer feedback.

**Lead AI\-Native Product Development**


* Architect the product with AI and machine learning at its core—for example: intelligent automation, contextual recommendations, predictive insights, and generative AI–powered workflows that reduce effort for end users.
* Collaborate closely with data science and engineering teams to translate cutting\-edge AI capabilities into practical, regulation\-aware product features.
* Design for the end user first—building intuitive, collaborative workflows that reduce burden and enable clinical development and clinical operations teams to work seamlessly together, with connectivity across Evinova’s modules.
* Meet users where they are and guide them through their change management journey—earning adoption by easing the transition to new, AI\-enabled ways of working rather than forcing it.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving clinical trial and AI landscape—proactively identifying opportunities to apply emerging capabilities to the challenges faced by clinical development and clinical operations teams.

**Drive Strategic Leadership Across Evinova**


* Partner with a matrixed product organization to drive connectivity across Evinova’s modules and inform the product roadmap. Partner with commercial to ensure the product does not over\-fit to any one customer. Iterate relentlessly in pursuit of product\-market fit.
* Serve as the strategic product leader across the organization, aligning engineering, design, data science, and commercial around a unified product vision.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade\-offs to Evinova’s executive leadership and key enterprise customers.
* Define and own success metrics—adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, clinical trial cycle\-time reduction—and drive data\-informed prioritization.

**Operate with Entrepreneurial Ownership**


* Treat your product area as your own business—own the P\&L mindset, make resource trade\-offs, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.
* Navigate the tension between speed\-to\-market and regulatory compliance (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with data providers and standards bodies (CDISC, HL7 FHIR) to accelerate Evinova’s product capabilities.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, intellectual honesty, and continuous learning within your product area and across the broader Evinova team.

**WHAT YOU BRING**


**Required Experience**


* 8\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a director\-level or senior product leadership capacity owning a product area end\-to\-end.
* Domain experience in clinical trials or life sciences. You bring a deep understanding of the clinical development and clinical operations personas, know the clinical ecosystem (EDC, CDMS, CTMS, eTMF), and can engage credibly with clinical operations leaders, medical directors, biostatisticians, data managers, and regulatory professionals.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial track record: you have taken at least one product from zero to one—as a founder, early\-stage PM, or intrapreneur within a larger organization. You can point to products you conceived, shipped, and scaled.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI/ML\-powered products. You understand model development lifecycles, training data strategies, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and the unique UX challenges of AI\-driven features. AI fluency is non\-negotiable for this role.
* Proven ability to operate in enterprise B2B SaaS environments, including navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, long sales cycles, and platform\-level product decisions.
* Strong technical acumen: comfortable partnering directly with engineers and data scientists, reviewing technical specifications, and contributing to architectural trade\-off decisions.

**AI Fluency Expectations**


* You use AI tools daily in your own workflow—for research, analysis, writing, prototyping, and decision\-making—and can articulate how AI is transforming product development practices.
* You can evaluate AI/ML model outputs, reason about precision/recall trade\-offs, and make informed product decisions around model thresholds, confidence scoring, and human\-in\-the\-loop design patterns.
* You maintain a current and informed perspective on the AI landscape—foundation models, agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, fine\-tuning—and have a point of view on how these capabilities apply to regulated industries like clinical research.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience as a founder or co\-founder of a technology company, or as the first product hire at an early\-stage start\-up.
* Working knowledge of clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM/ADaM, CDASH) and regulatory submission workflows.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About iSpeedToLead**
----------------------


iSpeedToLead is a two\-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated\-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.

**About the role**
------------------


This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.


You will own the post\-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high\-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.


One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Onboarding and activation**

* Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.
* Run onboarding calls and follow\-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.
* Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.

**Account health and retention**

* Manage a book of high\-value accounts with regular check\-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.
* Build and maintain a health\-scoring model that flags at\-risk accounts before they churn, not after.
* Run save conversations on at\-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.

**Escalations and problem\-solving**

* Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.
* Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.
* Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.

**Voice of the customer**

* Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.
* Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.
* Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.

**Process and reporting**

* Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win\-back, and escalation.
* Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.
* Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.

**Collaboration**

* Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.
* Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2\+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high\-volume, low\-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self\-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.)
* Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat\-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became.
* Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them.
* Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health\-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing.
* Written and spoken English at C1 level, customer\-facing, at volume.
* Confident on the phone with US small\-business customers. Our buyers are real estate investors: direct, busy, and blunt.
* Practical use of AI tools in your daily workflow (call summarisation, drafting, triage) with examples you can show.
* A minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in real estate, proptech, lead generation, or a marketplace with wallet or prepaid\-balance mechanics.
* Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, or a comparable CRM and support stack.
* Experience designing lifecycle email or automation flows.
* Ukrainian or Russian in addition to English.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Full ownership of a metric that shows up directly in the P\&L, with no layer between you and leadership.
* A greenfield function. You design how Customer Success works here.
* Real data infrastructure and an AI\-native team, so arguments get settled with numbers and tooling is not a fight.
* A clear 12\-month growth path to Head of Retention or Head of Customer Success, including automation of the low\-touch tier and one to two direct reports.
* Remote work with flexible hours inside the required US overlap.
* Referral bonus of USD 3,000 after probation for anyone you bring in.

* 5 years of experience in facilities maintenance or equivalent related functions.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to lead and manage teams and projects.
* Attention to detail but also to see the implications for the bigger picture
* Commercial and customer service awareness
* Organisation, time management, prioritising and the ability to handle various things at the same time.
* Good knowledge of IT packages.
* Fluent Spanish and English is a must.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.  



If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.
