As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

title: Lifestyle Agent
description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Your New Role...**
Join Warner Bros. Pictures and play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering publicity campaigns for the theatrical slate in Spain. Working closely with the Senior Director of Publicity, Italy and Spain, you will ensure campaigns are culturally relevant, aligned with international objectives, and generate meaningful audience engagement and earned media impact.
If you are passionate about entertainment publicity, thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy working across high\-profile film releases, we would love to hear from you.**Your Role Accountabilities*** Oversee Spanish publicity campaigns from strategy through execution, localising global plans to maximise relevance and impact within the Spanish market while identifying creative opportunities that drive earned media coverage and audience engagement.
* Act as the primary publicity contact for Spain, partnering with cross\-functional teams across Marketing, Distribution, Creative, Social, Media and Promotions, while coordinating relationships with filmmakers, talent teams and external PR agencies.
* Lead the planning and delivery of publicity activity in Spain, including talent tours, premieres, special screenings, awards campaigns, film festival participation and other cultural moments that enhance campaign visibility.
* Coordinate talent schedules, oversee tour and junket logistics, and manage supplier negotiations and onboarding processes, including purchase orders, vendor creation and contracts.
* Coordinate the Spanish publicity budget, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and KPIs, and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across print, broadcast, online and influencer media, securing high\-quality editorial coverage and coordinating participation in local and international media opportunities.
* Support publicity strategies for local productions, oversee publicity materials and media monitoring activities, and coordinate the publicity team while supporting their development and ensuring delivery across multiple film titles.

**Qualifications \& Experience*** Extensive experience in publicity, communications or PR within an entertainment company, film studio, media organisation or specialised agency in a management level position.
* Excellent written and spoken English skills with the ability to draft, adapt and present clear communications for local and international stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of the Spanish media landscape, including entertainment, film, lifestyle, online and influencer media.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
* Collaborative approach with experience working effectively with internal teams, external agencies, media partners and international offices.

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. title: Associate Director, Real Estate Investment Banking
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Marketing Administration Executive
description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain**

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.


**Job Description**

This is a **hybrid** role. As a **Marketing Administration Executive** , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day running of marketing operations across France, Spain and Portugal. Acting as the backbone of the regional marketing team, you will coordinate key administrative processes, manage budgets and supplier payments, support compliance requirements, and help ensure marketing activity is delivered efficiently and in line with internal processes.


Reporting to the **Head of Southwestern Europe** , you will be part of the **Southwestern Europe Marketing Team** , who are responsible for developing and delivering local marketing strategies and campaigns across France, Spain and Portugal. The team works closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to drive growth, strengthen brand presence and deliver impactful customer experiences across multiple markets. This role plays a vital part in supporting the operational effectiveness of the team and ensuring marketing activity can be executed seamlessly.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-paced international marketing team, where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple functions and markets. You'll have the chance to make a tangible impact by improving processes, supporting key stakeholders, and helping the team operate effectively. If you're highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoy being at the centre of a busy, collaborative environment, **could this be the perfect next step for you?**

You Will:


* Coordinate the creation, tracking and renewal of marketing contracts, ensuring the correct approval processes are followed and records are maintained accurately.
* Raise and track purchase orders across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring spend aligns with approved budgets and supplier requirements.
* Process and monitor marketing invoices, working closely with suppliers, Finance and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support timely payments.
* Maintain budget trackers, reconciliations and reporting updates, providing marketing teams with accurate visibility of committed and actual spend.
* Support procurement and supplier onboarding activities by coordinating required information, following up approvals and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Coordinate marketing\-related compliance information requirements across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring information is collected, organised and submitted on time.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, records and trackers, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and up to date.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the regional marketing team, including meeting coordination, supplier follow\-up, document preparation and process management.
* Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and external partners to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of marketing operations.

**Qualifications**

You Have:


* Works carefully and accurately, checking details before sharing information or moving a process forward.
* Plans work clearly, keeps trackers up to date and follows through on agreed actions.
* Collaborates well with colleagues across different markets and functions, adapting communication to the person and situation.
* Asks questions early when something is unclear and follows the right approval routes.
* Responds calmly to changing priorities and helps others understand what is needed to keep work moving.
* Looks for simple improvements that make recurring administration easier, clearer and more consistent.

**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire you. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:


* A regular bonus and great pension.
* €9\.60 food vouchers per day.
* 25 days annual leave
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

**Equal Opportunities** .


If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.


We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.


We're an **equal opportunities employer** . We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.


We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Search Media Manager || CDMO
description:
Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries.
  
  

A Day in the Life
  
  

As the Multidivision Search Media Manager for CDMO in Spain \& Portugal, reporting to the Multidivision Head of Media, you will be a key player in shaping our media strategy build the strategic roadmap, ensure technical excellence, and capitalize on emerging AI search solutions to drive business growth within all Search touchpoints. You'll work closely with marketing teams, media community, our media agency, and other key stakeholders to maximize the impact of our campaigns. This role offers a unique blend of strategic planning, hands\-on execution, and collaborative teamwork, allowing you to make a significant contribution to the growth of our brands in the Spanish \& Portuguese market.
  
  

* Search Strategy: Define and lead the One Search strategy across divisions, ensuring an integrated approach across Paid Search, SEO, Amazon, TikTok Search and emerging LLM environments.
* AI \& Next\-Gen Search Growth: Ensure strong website visibility across each brand’s must\-win territories within LLMs and AI\-powered search, while identifying and capitalizing on new paid media opportunities within these environments (Google Ads: AI Max, Chat GPT Ads…).
* Performance \& Search Excellence: Drive Search performance through clear KPIs and excellence standards, including
* SEA: Search Golden Rules compliance, Housekeeping excellence, naming convention full compliant.
* SEO\-to\-GEO: Top visibility, Website excellence \& GEO readiness, AI adoption, must\-win territory visibility and campaign performance.
* Brand Activation \& Agency Leadership: Partner with Marketing and Media teams to translate brand priorities into effective Search activations, acting as the key strategic SPOC for media agencies across Paid and Organic Search.
* Tools, Capabilities \& Community Enablement: Act as the Melody Champion and key reference within the Media CDMO team, driving adoption, best\-in\-class usage and know\-how across the Media Community, while fostering broader Search capabilities and best practices.
* AI Media Champion: Accelerates the adoption of generative and analytical artificial intelligence tools across a company's media
* Develop strong relationships with Zone \& Global media colleagues to build \& share best practices and influence on key issues affecting market


We Are Looking For
  
  

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, a skilled communicator, and a data\-driven decision\-maker. You are passionate about the beauty industry and possess a deep understanding of the media landscape. Your skills include:
  
* People Developer: Ability to mentor and guide team members.
* Strategist: Proven ability to develop and execute successful media strategies.
* Innovator: A proactive approach to identifying and implementing new media opportunities.
* Integrator: Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Entrepreneur: A proactive and results\-oriented approach to problem\-solving.
* Knowledge of Media Platforms \& Tools: Expertise in various media platforms and analytical tools.
* Strategic Planning: Ability to develop and implement comprehensive media strategies.


What’s In It For You
  
* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference


Who We Are
  
  

L’Oréal is present in 150 markets on five continents. For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to ‘Create beauty that moves the world’; it is now the industry world leader with €29 billion consolidated sales. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone \& our planet. Experience the excitement of agility to shape the future of beauty; where diversity and purpose come together create meaningful impact.
  
  

We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and to advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. The Group strictly prohibits discrimination against any applicant for employment because of the individual’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, visible and/or invisible disabilities, socio\-economic and/or multicultural origins, health conditions, age, religion, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Sr. Analyst , Global Operational Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

  

About the team  

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large\-scale data analysis, automation, and cross\-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
* Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.


\- Experience with GenAI/LLM integration \- building AI\-assisted analytical tools, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic workflows.  

* Experience with statistical analysis and experimentation (design of experiments, causal inference, A/B testing) and ML/data\-mining pipelines.
* Knowledge of supply\-chain operations (inventory placement, network optimization, transportation, fulfillment) and Amazon internal data systems (Andes/Redshift, Cradle, Data Central, EDX).

description:
**Summary**
-----------

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects to join the Digital \& Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.


In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. You will work with regional and global teams, hotels, agencies, and external partners to drive customer and World of Hyatt member acquisition, conversion, engagement, loyalty, and retention.

  

**Who We Are**

  

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest\-growing hospitality companies.


Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

  

**The Role**

  

Reporting to the Director, Digital \& Direct Channels South EAME, the **Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects** will be responsible for coordinating the strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM initiatives, digital campaigns, and projects related to the web and digital ecosystem.

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

  

* Coordinate campaigns, tactics, and touchpoints aimed at Hyatt guests and World of Hyatt members, using segmentation, personalization, and data analysis to improve engagement, conversion, and direct bookings.
* Manage the relationship calendar and ensure the proper alignment of campaigns with commercial, regional, global, and hotel priorities.
* Lead the execution and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, ensuring alignment with direct\-channel performance objectives.
* Coordinate promotions and activations across the digital ecosystem, managing timelines, content, assets, and messaging across different touchpoints.
* Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
* Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
* Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Analyze customer behavior and feedback to continuously improve CRM initiatives and the digital customer experience.
* Ensure CRM processes comply with GDPR and best practices in data governance and data quality.
* Coordinate relationships with CRM and digital agencies across South EAME and the wider EAME region, ensuring consistency in strategy, reporting, execution, and best\-practice adoption.

**Who You Are**

  

You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results\-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.


You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.

  

**We Welcome You**

  

Research shows that individuals often apply for jobs only when they meet all the listed qualifications. If you do not meet every requirement but feel inspired by this opportunity and believe you can bring value, we encourage you to apply.

------------------


**Qualifications**

  

* At least 3 years of professional experience in CRM, digital marketing, digital campaigns, or a closely related field.
* Experience planning, executing, and analyzing digital and CRM campaigns.
* Experience coordinating projects and working with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Experience working with external agencies, preferably in regional or international environments.
* Knowledge of marketing, digital analytics, CRM, personalization, content, ecommerce, and cloud\-based technology platforms.
* Experience with platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, metasearch, display/programmatic, and affiliate marketing.
* Strong analytical and results\-oriented mindset, combining creativity with a data\-driven approach.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, international environment with multiple priorities.
* High level of English, both written and spoken; additional languages will be considered an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Previous experience with Hyatt and Hyatt systems will be considered an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is preferred.

We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.
* **Drive change management and adoption of new ways of working**
* Lead change readiness, stakeholder impact assessment, adoption planning, and reinforcement for procurement tools, processes, digital solutions, and AI\-enabled use cases where relevant.
* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, resistance, confusion, or capability gaps, and drive practical actions to address them.
* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.

description:
Madrid

International environment

**Do you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and building things from scratch?**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Combo, we're looking for our next **Customer Success Manager to take care of our Spanish market**.


Spain is a strategic market for Combo. We already have an established local Sales team and a growing customer base. Our next challenge is to continue structuring our Customer Success approach while ensuring our Spanish customers get the support and experience they need to succeed with Combo.


This is a highly hands\-on and operational role.


You won't simply manage a portfolio of customers. You'll take ownership of their overall experience: from supporting key accounts to handling day\-to\-day requests, while also building scalable processes that will allow us to grow.

**More than 150,000 employees use Combo every day.**
----------------------------------------------------


To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.


At Combo, we build HR solutions for companies with deskless teams: restaurants, hotels, retailers, pharmacies, bakeries, sports and leisure businesses, and more.


The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

**This role is made for you if...**
-----------------------------------


You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.


When something isn't working perfectly, your first instinct is to understand the situation and find a practical solution.


You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


You care about the quality of your work, especially when it comes to customer follow\-up and data. For you, keeping a clean and reliable CRM isn't just a detail.


You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**A gross annual fixed salary between €34K and €41K**, depending on your experience.


And also:

* **Stock options** once your probation period has been successfully completed
* ️ **Meal vouchers**
* **A 40\-hour working week**
* A role based in our **Madrid office**
* An international environment, working closely with teams in France
* A high\-impact role with real ownership over a strategic market and customer base
* ️ The opportunity to build, structure, and improve the way we support our customers in Spain
* A close\-knit local Sales team, backed by an established and growing European scale\-up
* Plenty of autonomy and room to make an impact

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

**Step 1 – HR Screening (30 min)**


A first conversation with **Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager**, to get to know each other, tell you more about Combo, and discuss your experience and expectations.

**Step 2 – Management Fit (60 min)**


A conversation with **Estelle, Head of Customer Success**, to discuss the role in more detail, your experience, and how you approach Customer Success and customer management.

**Step 3 – Skill Test**


A practical exercise designed to better understand how you approach real\-life situations you could face in the role.

**Step 4 – Culture Fit**


A final meeting at our **Madrid office**, where you'll get to meet the team and learn more about how we work at Combo.

**Our commitment**
------------------


At Combo, we believe diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create stronger companies.


We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

title: Creativity and Culture Editor
description:
Overview:

ABOUT THE JOB  

Working within Creative Review
Creative Review is a trusted source of insight, ideas and inspiration for the creative industries, covering design, advertising and the wider creative sector. Established in 1980, the brand has evolved from a print magazine into a multi\-platform proposition spanning digital, print, social media, newsletters, podcasts, events and the Creative Review Annual Awards.


As part of Haymarket, Creative Review connects a highly engaged creative community with the ideas, people and developments shaping the industry. Through its editorial content, events and wider brand offering, Creative Review informs and inspires its audience while creating opportunities to grow its reach and impact across the creative industries.

  

The Role* The Creativity and Culture Editor will lead Creative Review’s coverage of new global design, advertising and wider cultural projects across digital, social and CR’s wider platforms.
* The role will develop and deliver a strong editorial strategy that showcases the best creative work, celebrates industry talent and explores the cultural trends shaping the advertising and design industries. Through high\-quality journalism, analysis and multimedia content, the role will grow Creative Review’s reputation as the leading destination for creative professionals.
* The Creativity and Culture Editor will build and maintain strong global industry relationships and collaborate with editorial, commercial and events teams to develop engaging content, products and experiences that grow audience engagement and support Creative Review’s wider objectives.


Responsibilities:  

Key Responsibilities  

Editorial Strategy \& Content Development  

* Lead Creative Review’s coverage of new design, advertising and commercial creative projects across digital, social and multi\-media platforms, delivering high\-quality journalism that informs and inspires audiences.
* Write, commission and edit new work content, plus features, analysis and opinion content covering the advertising, design and commercial creative industries.
* Identify emerging standout campaigns and design work, plus creative trends, influential talent and cultural developments to shape Creative Review’s editorial agenda.
* Maintain strong editorial judgement when curating creative work featured across Creative Review’s platforms, ensuring content meets the brand’s standards.
* Develop ideas for new editorial formats, products and audience propositions that strengthen Creative Review’s offering.

  

Audience Growth \& Multimedia  

* Lead the development and performance of Creative Review’s Work and Inspiration content.
* Use audience insight, analytics and industry feedback to grow engagement and support Creative Review’s audience strategy.
* Work with the Editor and Deputy Editor to develop Creative Review’s social, audio and video proposition.

  

Industry Engagement \& Commercial Collaboration  

* Build and maintain relationships with leading creatives, agencies, brands, producers, directors and emerging industry talent around the world.
* Represent Creative Review at industry events, conferences and awards, acting as an ambassador for the brand.
* Collaborate with commercial teams to support sponsored content and events while maintaining editorial integrity.

  

Key Relationships
The Creativity and Culture Editor works closely with the Editor, Deputy Editor and wider Creative Review team to deliver editorial strategy, audience growth and engaging content experiences. The role builds strong relationships with industry leaders, contributors and partners while collaborating internally across our Haymarket Events, Commercial, Content Labs, Studio teams.


Skills / Experience / Knowledge / Minimum Criteria:  

Knowledge* Strong understanding of the global advertising, design and commercial creative industries, including key agencies, studios, brands, talent and emerging trends.
* Knowledge of digital journalism, multimedia content production and evolving audience behaviours.
* Understanding of editorial standards, media law and maintaining journalistic integrity.
* Knowledge of audience analytics and content performance metrics to inform editorial decisions.
* Understanding of the relationship between editorial, commercial, events and audience teams within a B2B media environment.

  

Skills* Excellent writing, editing and editorial judgement skills, with the ability to produce engaging and accurate journalism.
* Strong ability to generate original ideas, identify trends and create agenda\-setting content.
* Excellent relationship\-building skills, with the ability to develop trusted contacts across the global creative industry.
* Confident presenter and communicator, with the ability to host, interview and represent Creative Review at events and across multimedia platforms.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to manage, coach and develop editorial talent.
* Ability to use audience insight and data to shape content strategy and improve engagement.

  

Experience* Significant experience as a journalist, reporter or editor within a respected publication, ideally covering advertising, creativity, marketing or related industries.
* Proven experience producing and commissioning high\-quality journalism across digital, print or multimedia platforms.
* Experience building strong industry contacts and generating original stories and insights.
* Experience managing or mentoring journalists and supporting their development.
* Experience producing podcasts, video content or other multimedia formats.
* Experience representing a brand at industry events, conferences or panels.


About You

  

* Passionate about journalism and creative storytelling.
* Curious and proactive, with strong industry knowledge and story instincts.
* Audience\-focused, using insight to shape content decisions.
* Creative and innovative, with a desire to develop new ideas and formats.
* Collaborative, building strong relationships across teams and industry contacts.
* Adaptable and organised, able to manage competing priorities.
* Confident and credible, representing Creative Review within the creative industry.
* Committed to editorial integrity and high standards.


What Success Looks Like


How will success in this role typically be measured?

* Delivery of high\-quality creativity and culture journalism across Creative Review platforms, particularly its Work and Inspiration section.
* Growth in audience engagement across creativity content and digital channels.
* Development of strong industry relationships and increased influence within the creative community.
* Successful management and development of the Work and Inspiration offering.
* Growth and performance of creativity\-focused multimedia content.

description:
**Job Description**
**About the Photo Direction Team**
 Housed within Pottery Barn’s Creative department, the Photo Direction team translates the brand’s creative
   

  

 vision into compelling photography and videography that inspires our customers to decorate, entertain, and
   

  

 live beautifully in a home that reflects their individual style.
   

  

 Supporting Pottery Barn’s omni\-channel business, the team concepts, develops and executes the photographic vision for each season, creating beautiful, distinctive and consistently on\-brand imagery across digital, social, print, marketing, advertising and in\-store channels. We foster a highly collaborative, creative and positive environment and partner closely across Creative, Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Video and Social Media.
   

  

**Overview Of The Creative Director Role**
 The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for driving and creating Pottery Barn’s seasonal
   

  

 photographic vision, ensuring that the brand’s visual expression is distinctive, inspiring and consistent
   

  

 across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 Working closely with the Senior Vice President of Creative and Vice President of Creative and Photography,
   

  

 the Creative Director translates brand, product and seasonal direction into compelling visual concepts and
   

  

 establishes the creative framework that guides photography, video and related content.
   

  

 This role sees the big picture and is also responsible for executing the details. You are a
   

  

 sophisticated visual storyteller with a strong point of view on interiors, decorating, photography, styling and
   

  

 culture—and understand where Pottery Barn sits in that intersection.
   

  

 You also understand how to translate product and brand ideas into imagery that creates emotion,
   

  

 communicates a clear point of view and ultimately builds desire for the Pottery Barn brand. You have the ability to
   

  

 create compelling individual images while simultaneously knowing how to create cohesive images that form a campaign.
   

  

 The Creative Director leads and inspires Art Directors and extended creative teams while partnering with
   

  

 photographers, stylists, producers, set designers and cross\-functional leaders to bring seasonal campaigns
   

  

 and ongoing brand storytelling to life.
   

  

 You will report to the Vice President, Creative and Photography and work closely with the Senior Vice
   

  

 President of Creative.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with the SVP and VP of Creative to establish the overarching photographic and visual direction for seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives and key storytelling moments.
* Participate in seasonal concept showroom walk\-throughs and Product Development meetings to understand the product vision, key stories and priorities for each season.
* Translate seasonal product and brand direction into a clear creative vision that establishes the overall mood, storytelling approach, visual language and photographic point of view.
* With oversight from Vice President, Creative and Photography, lead the development and review of seasonal Creative Briefs, ensuring concepts reflect the intended brand vision and provide clear direction for Art Directors, photographers, stylists, producers and other creative partners.
* Establish and maintain Pottery Barn's photographic standards and overall visual "look and feel," ensuring consistency while continually evolving the brand's imagery.
* Provide creative leadership across multiple campaigns, shoots and seasonal chapters, maintaining a holistic view of how individual assets work together to create a cohesive customer experience.
* Guide Art Directors in developing decorating concepts, styling direction, camera approaches, lighting, set design and other visual elements that bring the approved creative direction to life.
* Partner with the VP Creative on photographer, stylist and creative talent selection based on the needs and visual objectives of each campaign.
* Review and guide set concepts and environmental storytelling to ensure rooms and spaces communicate a strong Pottery Barn point of view and appropriately showcase product.
* Provide senior\-level creative direction during key photography and video shoots, guiding mood, tone, composition, lighting, styling and overall visual execution.
* Inspire and develop Art Directors and broader creative teams, providing clear feedback, mentorship and creative guidance while fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Build productive creative partnerships with photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other external and internal creative talent.
* Partner closely with Merchandising and Product Development to ensure creative storytelling and product representation are aligned while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.
* Collaborate with E\-Commerce, Social, Video, Marketing and other channel partners to ensure the photographic vision translates effectively across customer touchpoints.
* Partner with Pagination and Creative teams to ensure imagery supports compelling layouts, storytelling and seasonal content needs.
* Review photography and video throughout the creative process, providing senior\-level direction on image selection, color, retouching, backgrounds, cropping, layouts and overall visual consistency.
* Anticipate creative challenges and proactively identify solutions that balance brand vision, product priorities, production realities and business needs.
* Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, curiosity and excellence while helping evolve Pottery Barn's visual expression and brand relevance.


**Criteria**
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in a visual or creative discipline such as advertising, interior design, interior architecture, graphic design, fine art or photography.
* Significant progressive creative leadership experience within photography, art direction, styling, editorial, advertising or related visual disciplines.
* Deep experience within home furnishings, lifestyle, interiors, retail, editorial or a similarly design\-driven industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate an overarching creative vision and translate brand\-level concepts into compelling visual storytelling.
* Exceptional visual judgment with a sophisticated understanding of interiors, decorating, styling, composition, photography, color and design.
* Proven ability to lead, inspire and develop Art Directors and multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Experience directing photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other creative partners.
* Strong conceptual thinker who can move fluidly between high\-level creative strategy and detailed visual execution.
* Ability to articulate creative ideas clearly and persuasively to creative teams, cross\-functional partners and senior executives.
* Highly collaborative, with demonstrated success partnering across Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Social, Video and other functions.
* Resourceful and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple creative initiatives and changing priorities while maintaining a consistently high visual standard.
* Strong understanding of the home furnishings and décor landscape with knowledge of current and emerging trends in interiors, photography, design and culture.
* Proven proficiency working within a digital\-first creative environment, including familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and contemporary creative workflows.
* Above all, you bring exceptional taste, strong creative instincts and a clear point of view, paired with the leadership skills to inspire others and translate Pottery Barn's brand vision into imagery that feels relevant, beautiful and unmistakably Pottery Barn.


**Our Culture \& Values**

**Full\-Time \& Part\-Time Opportunities**

------------------


Join an established, award\-winning, walk\-in, cash\-based chiropractic clinic with a strong and growing patient base in Groton and the surrounding eastern Connecticut community.


Our Groton clinic was voted **Best Chiropractic Clinic** and **Best Alternative Medicine Practice** in the **2026 Best of the Day Readers’ Choice Awards in Eastern Connecticut**.


Located in a strong military and submarine community, our clinic serves a diverse and highly engaged patient population.


Our practice focuses on full spinal and extremity adjustments using diversified and manual techniques, drop table, and activator. The Joint Chiropractic is the nation’s largest provider of chiropractic care through a growing network of clinics focused on making care convenient, affordable, and accessible.
